payload.instruction: transform the black DVD into a white DVD
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: What is the appearance of the DVD at the source location near the image center, distinct from the square case and the separate object to its right, in the edited image compared with the source?
node.criteria: Complete if the same DVD at the source location near the image center changes from black/dark in the source to white in the edited image. Partial if that same DVD shows a change toward white but is not white. Absent if that same DVD remains black/dark with no requested change. Unknown if the DVD cannot be reliably identified or its appearance or correspondence across images is insufficiently clear.
node.binding: Target: the small round DVD at approximately the image center in the source, not the adjacent square case or the separate black object to its right. Track that same location/object in the edited image; reference appearance: white.

outcome.description: Change the DVD from black to white.

response.content: {"status":"complete","evidence":"The small round DVD near the center is dark in the source and appears white in the edited image. The separate object to its right is not the target.","confidence":0.98}
